## Summary

- preserve the exact active workspace for ordinary New, Auto, and Pick Host launches
- keep a monorepo root at the root and a specifically opened nested project at that same nested path
- reserve `--project` for the explicit Pick Project action
- remove the cwd-to-project launch lookup and pin automatic remote placement with portable `--cwd`
- document and regression-test the launch contract

## Root cause

The extension called `agents projects view <workspace>` during an ordinary launch. That command answers containment attribution; at a monorepo root shared by child-project definitions, an equal weak match returned one child. The extension promoted that result to `--project`, dropped `--cwd`, and the CLI then correctly resolved the selected child’s `defaultPath`. The first wrong launch decision was the extension treating attribution as user intent.

Origin regression: phnx-labs/agi-cli#2503 / commit `9113ce5d`. Its tests covered serialization of an already selected project, not workspace-to-project inference at a shared root.

Tracking: [PHNX-3970](https://linear.app/getrush/issue/PHNX-3970/agi-ext-remote-launch-narrows-shared-monorepo-to-a-child-project)

## Run evidence

```text
ordinary: agents run claude --interactive --device auto --cwd /Users/example/src/monorepo --strategy balanced --mode auto
explicit: agents run claude --interactive --device auto --project child-a --strategy balanced --mode auto
```

The quoted commands come from executing the production `buildNewAgentLaunchCommand` in this branch. Ordinary routing retains the exact open folder, whether it is the monorepo root or a nested project; explicit Pick Project retains its intentional configured-path behavior.

## Verification

- `bun test src/core/launchTarget.test.ts src/vscode/extension.vscode.test.ts src/core/managedProjects.test.ts src/core/agents.test.ts` → 132 pass, 0 fail
- `bun run compile:ext` → pass
- `git diff --check` → pass
- full `bun test` before the nested-path clarification → 1784 pass, 8 fail
- full `bun test` on untouched `origin/main` (`f4d04a8`) → 1781 pass, the exact same 8 fail

The eight pre-existing failures are four `App unified task refresh` cases (`clsx` is absent from the root dependency set), two `renameTerminal` suite-order test-double cases, and two markdown renderer expectations. This change introduced four passing regression tests and no new full-suite failure.

The exact branch artifact built successfully on macOS with all runtime dependencies and installed as 0.9.364 in VS Code and VSCodium. Further live-editor interaction is intentionally paused; no additional window reload or UI verification will be performed without the owner explicitly requesting it.
